<Heading

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/diagnostics/reports"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stores a diagnostic report for this server's admins, who read it on
the admin UI's Diagnostics page. The mobile app sends one only when the
member records a feed scroll (Profile → Advanced) and taps "Send to
admin". The server never forwards a report anywhere, and deletes it
after 30 days. A member's own reports are part of their member export
and are deleted with their account.

`kind` selects the shape of `data`; only `feed_scroll` exists today.
Every number and string in `data` is bounded.

Rate-limited to 10 reports per hour per member. Only available on a
server that lists `diagnosticReports` in `features`.
